perCase.note:
Left out: Establish the candle's core material — soy wax, no paraffin — as a quality signal in the welcome email. — it states Soy wax only, paraffin-free, and the record(s) it cites say Soy wax, 40 hour burn, true, false.
Left out: Hand-poured in small batches signals craft and care — ideal tone for a welcome email. — it states Hand-poured in small batches, and the record(s) it cites say true, true.
Not on record: What is the scent profile or fragrance note of the Lavender candle specifically? (e.g. 'floral', 'fresh', 'earthy lavender') — record this against product.lavender_candle.fragrance_note so the welcome email can describe the scent experience.
Not on record: Is there a candle vessel / container detail for the Lavender candle (e.g. glass jar, tin, size)? Record as product.lavender_candle.vessel so the email can paint a visual picture for the reader.

Not on record: The Rose candle's burn time is not recorded against that product. Owner should record: 'Rose candle burn time = X hours' to allow burn-time claims for that item.
Not on record: No record states WHY soy wax specifically produces a longer burn compared to paraffin (e.g. a slower, cooler burn rate). Owner could record a factual statement such as: 'Soy wax burns cooler and slower than paraffin, extending burn time.' if they want that explanation in copy.
Not on record: No record covers whether the 40-hour burn time applies to the range as a whole or only to the Lavender candle. Owner should confirm and record burn hours against each product individually.
Removed "The customer's candle journey starts here." — nothing on record can support a capability claim.
Removed "The customer has arrived." — it says something about the reader's own order or booking, and nothing here knows who is reading it.
Not on record: everything — the business's records could not be read just now

Left out: Describe the treatment process — hair wash first, then treatment applied. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Left out: Reassure the reader that ammonia-based products are not used — a meaningful differentiator for a hair treatment. — it states Ammonia wale products use nahi karte., and the record(s) it cites say false.
Not on record: What result or outcome does the keratin treatment deliver for the client's hair? (e.g. smoothness, frizz reduction, shine — record this against product.keratin_treatment so it can be stated in copy)
Not on record: How long do the results of the keratin treatment last? Record this against product.keratin_treatment.result_duration if known.
Not on record: Is there any aftercare instruction the client should follow after the session? Record this against product.keratin_treatment.aftercare if known.
Removed "This is the first step of the customer's keratin journey." — it says something about the reader's own order or booking, and nothing here knows who is reading it.
Removed "The customer has made an enquiry." — it says something about the reader's own order or booking, and nothing here knows who is reading it.
Removed "The customer has made an enquiry." — it says something about the reader's own order or booking, and nothing here knows who is reading it.
Removed "There are no hidden charges." — Fact states the price upfront (₹3500) but does not state that there are no hidden charges. Absence of mention of hidden charges is not the same as stating they don't exist..
